meta.name: tfx-index
meta.description: 프로젝트 구조를 빠르게 파악하거나 토큰을 절약할 때 사용한다. '인덱싱', '프로젝트 구조', '인덱스 만들어', '코드베이스 맵', '프로젝트 개요' 같은 요청에 사용. 새 프로젝트 온보딩, 세션 시작 시 컨텍스트 효율화에 적극 활용.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成项目结构索引，快速理清新代码库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手新代码库，想快速理清结构再动手。
copy.tagline_en: Generate a project structure index to get a quick handle on any codebase.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over a repo and want a structural map before diving in.

howto.what: Claude 会把扫描和索引生成交给 Antigravity CLI，然后写出 PROJECT_INDEX.md（目录树、关键文件、依赖等）和 PROJECT_INDEX.json，供后续会话快速了解项目、节省 token。
howto.when: 当用户说“索引”、“项目结构”、“创建索引”等，或使用 /tfx-index 命令时触发；也用于新项目开工、会话开始时了解项目。

say.text: 给这个项目建立完整索引
更新项目索引，只处理变更部分
say.note: 只重扫变更文件，速度更快

howto.what_en: Claude delegates scanning and index generation to the Antigravity CLI, then writes PROJECT_INDEX.md (directory tree, key files, dependencies) and PROJECT_INDEX.json. These give later sessions a quick project overview and save tokens.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'index', 'project structure', 'create index', or similar, or uses the /tfx-index command. Also used for new project onboarding or context at session start.

say_en.text: Create a full index for this project.
Update the project index, only changed parts.

say_en.note: Builds index for that directory only.
